attribution.note: Marcus's own item heading in his own post. The embedded material it introduces isn't quoted, but the heading itself is his assertion.

semantics.note: 'Brings racist tropes to life' fairly means GenAI is being used to make content depicting racist tropes. This is an unhedged observation about the present.

contract.note: The plain reading and the June–July 2025 window fit his framing of examples read in 'the last few days'. The added 'spreading' element goes slightly beyond his words but doesn't change the result.

evidence.note: The Verge, 2 Jul 2025, reports Media Matters' findings: AI-generated videos full of racist tropes drew millions of TikTok views two days before the post.
Same article. AI provenance rests on the Veo watermark and the 8-second clip limit. That is reasonable evidence, even though the headline hedges with 'may have been'.

reviews.rationale: A reputable outlet, reporting watchdog research dated just before the post, documents widely viewed AI-generated videos with racist tropes. The Veo watermark gives reasonable evidence they were AI-made. The packet contains no counterevidence, which meets the support condition.
